text:
deploy-bot: starting rollout release-3.4.0 -> canary (10%) multi-region at 7245554321. monitoring p95, error-rate, kv-cache. autopilot=enabled (auto_revert=true) but maintenance-override=active for eu-west1.
morgan: seeing p95 spike on embeddings in eu-west1 at 7245554327, hosts show consistent 250ms vs baseline 80ms. dash: https://internal.metrics/redwood/3.4.0/eu-west1
alex: wait — autopilot is enabled globally but maintenance-override is preventing auto_revert in eu-west1. that explains why deploy-bot didn't rollback.
tim-oncall: so we need manual action for eu-west1. options: (1) remove maintenance-override to allow autopilot revert (2) manual targeted rollback/pin for embeddings in eu-west1 (3) reduce canary slice for eu-west1 to 0 and route to prior version. Thoughts?
morgan: prefer option 3: targeted traffic-slice to 0% for embeddings in eu-west1 and pin to 3.3.9. avoids flipping maintenance flags mid-deploy.
alex: +1. also prepare a quick feature-flag to reduce kvcache footprint if metrics show pressure.
support-bot: created ticket RED-7725 "eu-west1 embeds latency on 3.4.0" and queued customer-notify draft.
legal-bot: flagged for review if any SLA thresholds breached. no breach yet but account teams should be told.
morgan: executing: `redwoodctl rollout traffic-set --region=eu-west1 --route=embeddings --canary=0 --target=3.3.9`
alex: pinning command ready: `redwoodctl versions pin --region=eu-west1 --route=embeddings --version=3.3.9 --reason "p95 regression on 3.4.0 canary"`
morgan: traffic-set completed 7245554336. embeddings canary -> 0% in eu-west1. metrics will converge for slice in ~2m.
alex: pin applied 7245554338. `redwoodctl show pins` confirms region-scoped pin.
support-bot: customer draft: "We've temporarily reverted the embeddings update for EU traffic due to a latency regression observed during deployment. No data loss expected. We're monitoring closely." queued to affected accounts.
tim-oncall: action items: 1) morgan confirm metrics stable 2) alex open kvcache FF PR 3) support send customer note 4) legal on-call looped. ack?
morgan: ack. metrics show p95 back to ~85ms on pinned slice at 7245554344.
alex: FF PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/5801 with `kvcache.max_ratio=0.8`. exec after canary verification.
support-bot: customer messages sent and account teams notified 7245554346.
tim-oncall: updating release tracker: state->embedded-eu-pinned, change-window note added. RCA owners: alex infra, morgan customer timeline.
morgan: STATUS: targeted rollback executed, eu-west1 embeddings pinned to 3.3.9, canary paused for that region. follow-up RCA in 48h. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout events recorded: traffic_set=7245554336 pin=7245554338 notify=7245554346 state_change=7245554348.
morgan: thanks team, closing thread and will sync into postmortem ticket RED-7725.
